parameters.description:
`nextcloudtalk-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `nextcloudtalk` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Nextcloud Talk URL from your stored secrets, injects your credential header, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds an extra per-enrollment credential via enrollment parameters.
parameters.summary: Relay a message through your own Nextcloud Talk by posting a native Nextcloud Talk payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's base64 of user:password for HTTP basic auth
